name: Stanly Ranch, Auberge Collection
insider_take: Napa's newest luxury ranch resort where vineyard views meet modern sophistication on 700 sprawling acres of wine country paradise.
whats_special: This brand-new Auberge Collection property opened in 2021 as Napa's first luxury ranch resort, featuring standalone cottages with private patios overlooking 90 acres of estate vineyards. The property sits on historic Stanly Ranch land, originally a working cattle ranch dating back to the 1800s, and maintains its agricultural heritage with on-site farming and a working vineyard that produces exclusive wines for guests.
pro_tip: Book the Ranch Experience package to get exclusive access to the property's private vineyard tastings and farm-to-table cooking classes using ingredients grown right on the estate.
dont_miss: The sunset horseback rides through the vineyard rows, followed by private tastings of the estate's limited-production Cabernet Sauvignon that's only available to hotel guests. The resort's location in the cooler Carneros region offers a unique microclimate perfect for both Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, making it a hidden gem even among Napa insiders.
pros: Luxury ranch-style resort in heart of Napa Valley wine country
Spacious suites and villas with private outdoor spaces
Farm-to-table dining experiences with local ingredients
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury positioning
Remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions
